summary.plain: A windowless hydrogen gas target, a large hybrid calorimeter and two fine-grained gas detectors, set up 5.5 metres downstream so they could see electrons scattered at tiny angles with no magnet in the way.
summary.technical: PRad: windowless cryo-cooled continuous-flow hydrogen gas target (4 cm cell), two-section 5.5 m vacuum chamber, two X-Y GEM detectors and the HyCal hybrid electromagnetic calorimeter covering 0.7-7.0 degrees with full azimuth, which also detects e-e (Moller) pairs for normalisation.

technology.quote: We used a magnetic-spectrometer-free method along with a windowless hydrogen gas target
technology.value: Magnetic-spectrometer-free setup: windowless hydrogen gas flow target, HyCal hybrid electromagnetic calorimeter and two GEM coordinate detectors
